[i]A dog that adventures everywhere with you.[/i]

[i]陪你一起到处冒险的狗。[/i]

[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]English[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size]

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Follows you[/b] — ask it to come along and it will follow you across maps, into buildings, the mines, the desert and Ginger Island.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Forages[/b] — it sniffs out forageables nearby, runs over at double speed, picks them up and carries them back to you.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Carries things[/b] — whatever it is holding is handed to you on arrival. Nothing is ever silently lost, even if you sleep or change map mid-trip.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Fights[/b] — it attacks nearby monsters. Damage is based on the [b]best weapon in your inventory[/b] (not just the one you are holding), including that weapon's enchantments.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Ultimate[/b] — a flashy area attack with a shouted move name. 10 second cooldown.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Talks[/b] — short, area-aware lines with season / weather / time-of-day variants. Around 1,490 lines covering 40 areas, shops and NPC houses.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Report[/b] — ask "今天怎么样？" (how was today?) for a summary of what it foraged and defeated.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Guard dog[/b] — if you are about to die, it warps in, blocks the hit, clears the map of monsters, heals you to 20%, says something, then goes home to recover.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]Languages[/b][/size]

The dog's dialogue was written in Chinese and now ships with a [b]complete English translation[/b] (1,492 lines). The game's language picks the file automatically — Chinese players see the original text, everyone else gets English.

Adding another language does not require touching any code: drop a JSON file into the mod's [font=Courier New]i18n/[/font] folder where the key is the original Chinese line. Translations are very welcome.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley [b]1.6+[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [b]4.0.0+[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]No other mods required[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[/color]
[list=1]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip [font=Courier New]DogCompanion[/font] into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/font].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]How to use[/b][/size]

Walk up to your dog, [b]face it[/b], and press the action key (right-click / X / controller A) to open its menu:

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]跟我来~[/font] — start following you[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]今天怎么样？[/font] — today's report[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]回家吧~[/font] — send it back to the farm[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
It auto-attacks monsters while following. Nothing else to configure. The ultimate fires on its own during combat.

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

A [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] is created in [font=Courier New]Mods/DogCompanion/[/font] on first run. There is no in-game config menu yet — edit the file by hand.

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]PickupRange[/b] (4) — radius in tiles for picking up dropped items[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]ForageRange[/b] (25) — radius in tiles for sniffing out forageables[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]EnemyRange[/b] (18) — radius in tiles for engaging monsters[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]BaseAttack[/b] (10) — attack used when you have no weapon[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]FollowSpeed[/b] (3.0) — movement speed in pixels/frame. Vanilla pet is about 2, the player about 3.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]DebugFollow[/b] (false) — leave this off. Writes a movement/dialogue trace to a log file, for troubleshooting only.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
If something looks wrong with the dog's movement, toggle that trace from the SMAPI console without restarting the game: type [font=Courier New]dogdebug[/font] (or [font=Courier New]dogdebug on[/font] / [font=Courier New]dogdebug off[/font]).

[size=4][b]Known issues[/b][/size]

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Occasional brief head-flick while walking.[/b] Once every second or two the dog may turn its head for a moment and turn back. The movement itself is correct — it is a cosmetic artifact in the walk animation / facing handling that the author has not managed to pin down. Pathing, following, foraging and combat are unaffected.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The dog's internal collision tile is offset roughly one tile to the right of its visible body. This is inherited from the vanilla pet bounding box and is deliberately preserved, because the pathfinding depends on that coordinate frame.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]Permissions[/b][/size]

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]You may translate this mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]You may include it in mod packs.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Please do not reupload it elsewhere without changes.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]中文[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]它能做什么[/b][/size]

你养的那只狗，终于不只是躺在门口晒太阳了。

它会陪你翻山越岭——进矿洞、下沙漠、上姜岛，你去哪它去哪。野葱和蘑菇它先替你叼回来；你问它一句「今天怎么样？」，它会一条条数给你听；你快要被打倒的那一刻，它会扑过来替你挡下那一击，然后自己回家趴着养伤。

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]跟随[/b] —— 喊一声就跟着你走，跨地图、进建筑、下矿洞、去沙漠和姜岛都跟得上。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]采集[/b] —— 嗅到附近的采集物就冲过去，用双倍速度跑，叼起来再送回来给你。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]叼东西[/b] —— 嘴里的东西到你身边就交给你。睡觉或中途换地图也不会凭空消失。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]战斗[/b] —— 自动打附近的怪。伤害按你[b]背包里攻击力最高的武器[/b]算（不只是手里拿着的那把），并且继承那把武器的附魔。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]大招[/b] —— 带招式名的范围攻击，10 秒冷却。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]说话[/b] —— 短句、看场景，分季节 / 天气 / 时段。40 个区域，约 1490 条。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]战报[/b] —— 问它「今天怎么样？」就汇报今天采到什么、打退什么。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]护主[/b] —— 你快死的时候它会传过来挡刀、清场、然后它自己家养伤。[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]语言[/b][/size]

台词原文是中文，现在附带[b]完整的英文翻译[/b]（1492 条）。游戏语言会自动选择文件——中文玩家看到原句，其他语言看到英文。

想加别的语言[b]不用改代码[/b]：往模组的 [font=Courier New]i18n/[/font] 文件夹里丢一个 json，键就是中文原句。非常欢迎贡献翻译。

[size=4][b]前置要求[/b][/size]

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]星露谷物语 [b]1.6+[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [b]4.0.0+[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]不需要其他模组[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]安装[/b][/size]

[/color]
[list=1]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]装好 SMAPI。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]把 [font=Courier New]DogCompanion[/font] 解压到 [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/font]。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]用 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]怎么用[/b][/size]

走到狗面前，[b]面朝它[/b]，按交互键（右键 / X / 手柄 A）打开菜单：

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]跟我来~[/font] —— 开始跟随[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]今天怎么样？[/font] —— 今天的战报[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]回家吧~[/font] —— 让它回农场[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
跟随时会自动打怪，不用额外设置。大招在战斗中自己放。

[size=4][b]配置[/b][/size]

首次运行会在 [font=Courier New]Mods/DogCompanion/[/font] 生成 [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]。暂时没有游戏内的配置菜单，需要手动改文件。

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]PickupRange[/b] (4) —— 捡掉落物的范围（格）[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]ForageRange[/b] (25) —— 探测采集物的范围（格）[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]EnemyRange[/b] (18) —— 索敌范围（格）[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]BaseAttack[/b] (10) —— 没拿武器时的攻击力[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]FollowSpeed[/b] (3.0) —— 移动速度（像素/帧）。原版宠物约 2，玩家约 3[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]DebugFollow[/b] (false) —— 保持关闭。开启后会把移动/台词轨迹写进日志，只用于排查问题[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
如果觉得狗的行动有问题，可以在 SMAPI 控制台敲 [font=Courier New]dogdebug[/font] 打开轨迹日志（[font=Courier New]dogdebug on[/font] / [font=Courier New]dogdebug off[/font]），[b]不用重启游戏[/b]。

[size=4][b]已知问题[/b][/size]

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]走路时偶尔会快速扭一下头再扭回来[/b]，大约一两秒一次。移动本身是正确的，这是走路动画 / 朝向处理上的观感问题，作者尚未定位。寻路、跟随、采集、战斗都不受影响。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]狗的内部碰撞格比它身体靠右约一格。这来自原版宠物的包围盒，是[b]刻意保留[/b]的——寻路依赖那套坐标系，改掉反而会破坏寻路。[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]授权[/b][/size]

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]允许翻译。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]允许放进整合包。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]请不要换个说法就转载到别处。[/color][/*]
[/list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]跟我来~[/font] —— 开始跟随[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]今天怎么样？[/font] —— 今天的战报[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]回家吧~[/font] —— 让它回农场[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
跟随时会自动打怪，不用额外设置。大招在战斗中自己放。

[size=4][b]配置[/b][/size]

首次运行会在 [font=Courier New]Mods/DogCompanion/[/font] 生成 [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]。暂时没有游戏内的配置菜单，需要手动改文件。

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]PickupRange[/b] (4) —— 捡掉落物的范围（格）[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]ForageRange[/b] (25) —— 探测采集物的范围（格）[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]EnemyRange[/b] (18) —— 索敌范围（格）[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]BaseAttack[/b] (10) —— 没拿武器时的攻击力[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]FollowSpeed[/b] (3.0) —— 移动速度（像素/帧）。原版宠物约 2，玩家约 3[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]DebugFollow[/b] (false) —— 保持关闭。开启后会把移动/台词轨迹写进日志，只用于排查问题[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
如果觉得狗的行动有问题，可以在 SMAPI 控制台敲 [font=Courier New]dogdebug[/font] 打开轨迹日志（[font=Courier New]dogdebug on[/font] / [font=Courier New]dogdebug off[/font]），[b]不用重启游戏[/b]。

[size=4][b]已知问题[/b][/size]

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]走路时偶尔会快速扭一下头再扭回来[/b]，大约一两秒一次。移动本身是正确的，这是走路动画 / 朝向处理上的观感问题，作者尚未定位。寻路、跟随、采集、战斗都不受影响。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]狗的内部碰撞格比它身体靠右约一格。这来自原版宠物的包围盒，是[b]刻意保留[/b]的——寻路依赖那套坐标系，改掉反而会破坏寻路。[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
